info.title: Planet public API
info.summary: Read-only access to the Planet commodity purchasing-power index (PPI) on TON testnet.
info.description: Planet is an on-chain commodity purchasing-power index on TON. This API exposes the live basket and index. It is READ-ONLY: minting and redemption happen on-chain, signed by the user's own wallet (Planet never holds keys). Phase 1 proof of concept — the index is a synthetic construction, not a stablecoin, and carries no monetary value.

tags.name: status
tags.description: Live index, basket weights and accounting.

get.description: Returns the current PPI, the full basket (weights, base and current prices, risk state) and core accounting. Read live from PlanetCore get-methods (ppi, assetCount, assetAt, supply, reserve, lastOracleUpdate, ...). Responses are CDN-cached for 120s and carry an ETag; send `If-None-Match` to revalidate and get a 304.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: ETag from a previous response. If it still matches, the API replies 304 Not Modified with no body.

200.description: A live snapshot of the basket and index.

ETag.description: Weak validator; pass it back via If-None-Match.

304.description: Not Modified — the client's cached copy is still valid. No body.

503.description: The chain could not be read right now (public RPC rate-limited or unavailable). Retry after the `Retry-After` delay.

core.description: PlanetCore contract address this snapshot was read from.

isCurrentDeployment.description: False when the snapshot comes from the previous deployment (kept serving during a redeploy).

readMs.description: Wall-clock milliseconds the API spent reading the chain.

partial.description: True when some values could not be read in the time budget (the response is still 200).

ppi.description: Purchasing-power index. 1.0 = the base date; 6 decimals on-chain.

supply.description: Core-side mirrored supply of PLT (the jetton minter is the source of truth).

lastOracleUpdate.description: Unix seconds of the last accepted oracle push.

signerThreshold.description: M-of-N distinct signatures required by the oracle.

weight.description: Weight in ppm; 1e6 = 100%. Sums to 1000000 across the basket.

basePrice.description: Index base price (immutable once locked), 1e6 fixed point.

changePct.description: Percentage change of currentPrice vs basePrice.

riskState.description: 0 normal, 1 caution, 2 frozen (a frozen asset is excluded from the index and the rest renormalised).

code.description: Stable, machine-readable. Branch on this, not on the message.
